as_told.title: P3 assets given drug cocktails to interface with craft

plain: Some people with claimed psychic powers are said to be used in a secret US effort to summon unknown craft, and they are said to be treated badly and given cocktails of drugs so they can do the job. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says there is historical testimony to this, and that the treatment could put these people in danger or even kill them. Michels tells it too. He calls these people "P3 assets" and traces the account to Michael Herrera, a guest who says he saw a huge craft in the Indonesian jungle. Michels says that when they first interviewed Herrera in early summer 2024, what Herrera knew was that these people were treated like garbage and drugged so they could connect with the craft.
